summary: PO 2020 section 6: 90 ECTS compulsory foundation modules (B1 to B15), then 78 ECTS of advanced modules: B16, B17 and B18 (6 ECTS each), key competencies B25 (12 ECTS), and exactly two of the five specializations (24 ECTS each: two compulsory 6-ECTS modules plus a 12-ECTS Wahl module). The two specialization categories have to be different specializations, and a module fills only one of them; this form cannot check those two conditions. At least one exam among B16 to B25 must be a seminar, at least 6 ECTS of foundation or advanced modules must be taught and examined in English (language courses do not count), and 60 ECTS of foundation modules are required before B16 to B24.

categories.name: Key competencies
categories.note: Compulsory module B25, 12 ECTS. Additive key competencies, student engagement, language courses, internships, study-abroad courses, and non-economics courses from other bachelor programs can count; a course with no real difference from another module already taken cannot.

options.id: Aufbaumodule > Finance, Accounting, Controlling and Taxation

categories.note: One specialization under section 6, worth 24 ECTS: both of its compulsory modules (6 ECTS each) and its 12-ECTS Wahl module. Only modules from that one specialization count.

options.id: Aufbaumodule > Finance, Accounting, Controlling and Taxation

categories.note: The second specialization, also 24 ECTS, with its own two compulsory modules and its own 12-ECTS Wahl module. It has to be a different specialization, and a module already used for the first fills only one slot; the form cannot check those two conditions.
